description: This is a CMake script defining a function 'compile_aidl' used to generate source code from AIDL files during build time. It includes documentation and implementation for invoking the AIDL compiler with various options.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function that automates the invocation of the aidl compiler to generate source code from aidl files with configurable options.
